description: Ripple 65B Preview is Ricursive Intelligence's Apache 2.0-licensed, 65-billion-parameter reasoning model for coding and agentic tasks. It accepts and returns text, supports automatic tool calling and JSON output, and has a 16,384-token context window shared by input and output. It reasons before answering by default, and this preview's thinking cannot be reliably turned off.
name: Ripple 65B Preview
